title: Proposed AI evidence dataset 0.1.0
description: Portable design prototype. Not the existing pdoom.live import schema and not a production migration.

dataset_kind.description: Synthetic is a fixture namespace, never research evidence.

records.description: All referenced revisions must be in this self-contained bundle.

decimal.description: Exact base-10 value; no exponent, commas, NaN, Infinity or binary floating-point JSON number. Original lexical precision is retained.

record_id.description: Persistent, type-prefixed identifier. Never reused for a different entity or observation.

revision.description: Exact immutable revision, never implicit latest.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp ending Z, at most six fractional digits; real calendar date is checked by FormatChecker.

language.description: BCP47-style language tag, for example en or zh-Hans; und for undetermined. Syntax check is not full IANA registry validation.

unit.description: Versioned unit identifier. Currency basis, score scale, hardware type and denominators belong in metric context.

at.description: Actual timestamp; do not invent midnight for date-only evidence.

date.description: Actual calendar day when day precision is all that is known.

precision.description: Precision supported by the source; endpoints are inclusive dates.

reason.description: Why no reliable time is available.

temporal.description: Source-supported time with explicit precision; range endpoints must be ordered.

level.description: Coverage probability, only for confidence or credible intervals.

bound.description: Lower limit, not a point estimate.
Upper limit, not a point estimate.

value.description: Value at q, in stated unit.

quantiles.description: Strictly increasing q; nondecreasing values. No implied distribution between quantiles.

value.description: Tagged value union; no midpoint substitutions or conversion of prose to invented probabilities.

key.description: Stable metric name, including a version when definitions change.

definition.description: What is counted or measured, including numerator and denominator.

direction.description: Direction under this metric, not a general safety judgment.

context.description: Hardware, currency base year, sample basis or other interpretation-critical context.

known_at.description: First recorded availability of this revision to this dataset; never backdate after late discovery.

retrieved_at.description: Time the underlying material was retrieved or captured for this revision.

published.description: When the underlying source was published.

event.description: When the described event happened, not its publication.

evaluated.description: When an evaluation was run; unknown with reason when not applicable.

source_ref.description: Source artifact and exact revision used.

locator.description: Page, section, table cell, transcript timestamp or other stable source selector.

excerpt.description: Optional short evidence text; distribute only if permitted.

extraction_method.description: How this evidence link was produced.

review_state.description: Evidence/attribution review; not a guarantee of truth.

reviewer_ref.description: Human or accountable organization recorded as reviewer.

rights_state.description: Export rights for content of this record; not inherited automatically from software or dataset license.

rights_basis.description: License, permission or reason for restriction; unknown is explicit.

publication_state.description: Eligible requires verified review and cleared rights; does not mean actually published.

version.description: Exact release or commit, not latest.

configuration.description: Prompt/scaffold, tools, sampling, token budget and scoring settings.

reproducibility.description: Whether inputs and execution environment can be recreated.

observation_mode.description: Reported: another party claims it. Measured: identifiable evaluator ran it. Estimated: derived using assumptions.

method.description: Method and source of estimate; disclose assumptions and transformations.

uncertainty_notes.description: Sampling, contamination, measurement error and other uncertainty not encoded in value.

title.description: Source title in its source language.

source_type.description: Artifact type, separate from publisher nationality.

author_refs.description: May be empty when unknown; never invent a person author.

review_status.description: Language review, separate from evidence review.

notes.description: Preserved ambiguity, changes in terminology or omitted material.

actor_kind.description: Entity type; a collective represents surveyed or market participants, not the publisher.

population_scope.description: Inclusion frame and wave-specific population; do not imply representativeness.

code.description: ISO3166-1 alpha-2, EU, global or unknown.

relationship.description: Geographic relationship, never inferred from language.

jurisdictions.description: Multiple jurisdictions allowed; an empty array means not established.

namespace.description: ORCID, ROR or other named identifier registry.

value.description: Identifier as assigned by that registry.

items.description: Person or institution making the claim.

speaker_refs.description: Attributed speakers, not merely mentioned people.

original_text.description: Short original-language statement or rights-cleared text.

normalized_text.description: Faithful normalized wording; preserve uncertainty and conditions.

topic_keys.description: Topics are labels, not exact questions.

translation_ref.description: Optional translation artifact used for normalized wording.

kind.description: How this statement relates to an earlier one.

relationships.description: No destructive replacement of old views.

version_label.description: Provider model version, not a mutable product name.

provider_model_id.description: Immutable provider or repository identifier, if available.

artifact_digest.description: Hash of immutable weights/configuration if available.

version_certainty.description: Whether underlying model identity is stable.

release_kind.description: Do not equate announcement with public availability.

availability_scope.description: Who could access it, geography and gating at event time.

items.description: Organization/person that ran or reports the benchmark.

split.description: Test/validation/private split, including unknown when undisclosed.

contamination_status.description: Training overlap status, not proof of independence.

independence.description: Who produced the evidence; replication is not merely a repeat citation.

items.description: Organization, model or infrastructure owner being measured.

scope.description: Per run, per token, annual, installed capacity or other denominator and boundary.

currency.description: ISO4217 original currency code. Conversion is optional and explicit.

conversion_method.description: Original currency, date and exchange/inflation source.

risk_domain.description: Evaluation domain, not observed real-world harm.

conclusion.description: What the observed test result supports; avoid converting it into global catastrophe probability.

limitations.description: Coverage, scaffolding, sample-size and transfer limitations.

items.description: Associated organizations/models; association is not causal proof.

subject_refs.description: May be empty when actor or model identity is unverified.

severity.description: Ordinal triage label with explicit rubric.

deduplication_key.description: Curated same-event cluster key; not an automatic truth claim.

impact.description: Optional measured impact with its own scope and uncertainty.

question_key.description: Stable exact-question key; broader topics must not use this key.

question_text.description: Full wording including outcome and condition.

conditioning.description: Explicit condition or literal unconditional. Never infer omitted conditions.

horizon.description: Deadline or event window; unknown if genuinely unspecified.

answer_unit.description: Required for probability and quantity domains.

resolution_rule.description: Criteria, evidence authority, deadline timezone and handling of ambiguity.

resolution_policy.description: Stored forecasts need not be objectively resolvable.

items.description: Person, organization or explicitly defined collective issuing the forecast.

statement_ref.description: Source statement when forecast is extracted from one.

forecast_origin.description: Inferred analysis stays a separate product.

as_of.description: When forecast was made or market snapshot observed, at source-supported precision; not retrieval time.

aggregation.description: A source-published aggregate, not an analyst-created pool of incompatible questions.

aggregation_method.description: Summary rule, weighting, dependence, selection and source cutoff; no incompatible questions.

population_ref.description: The collective whose views are summarized; separate from the publisher.

aggregator_ref.description: Organization/person that calculated or published the aggregate, not its respondents.

wave.description: Survey wave, panel round or exact market snapshot identifier.

sample_size.description: Respondents/traders represented in this estimate, when known.

sampling_notes.description: Sampling frame, nonresponse, repeated participants and why missing sample size is unknown.

question_ref.description: Exact question and criteria being resolved.

outcome.description: Only resolved cases carry an outcome.

resolved_at.description: Adjudication time, only for resolved cases.

rationale.description: Evidence, disputed points and how the rule was applied.

snapshot_kind.description: As-known freezes knowledge and review state as of the cutoff; it is not a claim that all included evidence passed human review.

cutoff.description: Maximum knowledge time for member records.

members.description: Closed set including referenced records; snapshot never contains itself.

notice.description: Coverage limitations, synthetic/live status, exclusions and rights limitations.

synthetic.description: True for test-only records, never mixed silently with real observations.

evidence.description: Traceable source references; empty only for source artifacts and snapshots.

supersedes.description: Immediately preceding revision of the same persistent record, for correction history.

key.description: Exact existing slug or identifier; no lossy implicit mapping.

legacy_refs.description: Optional additive bridge to the existing ledger.

dataset_id.description: Upstream dataset or provider identifier; preserve its own namespace.

release.description: Exact upstream release/version or dated snapshot identifier.

record_id.description: Original upstream row, question, run or cell identifier; never replace it silently.

schema_version.description: Original upstream schema version, or explicit unknown when not supplied.

source_ref.description: Evidence artifact for this upstream release or record.

description.description: Input fields, assumptions and any information loss.

transformations.description: Ordered transformations; empty means identity mapping without conversion.

upstream_refs.description: Crosswalk to upstream records. The upstream release stays authoritative; this envelope need not duplicate its whole dataset.
